generations.prompt: Medium close-up at dusk at the bottom of a deep excavation trench. Three people kneel side by side on planks laid on the black mud of a square sondage, at the edge of a square opening in its floor, looking down into it: an older woman with grey hair tied back in a dark field jacket, a bearded man in an olive cap, a woman with a long dark braid, all in blue nitrile gloves. Their faces are lit from below by bright blue daylight coming up through the opening; behind them the trench's dark earth walls are in dusk shadow. A light steady breeze from below stirs their hair upward. They do not speak and do not move except to breathe; their mouths stay closed and their hands stay on their knees; nobody reaches toward the opening. Camera is fixed, no camera movement. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
